name: bbva.com.uy
body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.bbva.com.uy scores 54 out of 100 (F). 6 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: plain http…

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, www.bbva.com.uy drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.1 found 39 elements on /personas.html, for example .header__access__desktop and .swiper-slide-active.complexmarqueenospacing[data-swiper-slide-index="0"] > .complexmarquee__base--left.complexmarquee__. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: The layout shifts by 2.079 while loading
fix.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower. Good is under 0.1.
fix.fix: Reserve space for images, ads, embeds, and late banners.

fix.title: 41 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Adobe Analytics appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every external link that was checked answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
Large images are served as WebP, AVIF or SVG
Every page has a meta description
